newsitem.title: USA: SeaChange lifts IPO price range to $14 to $16.
newsitem.headline: SeaChange lifts IPO price range to $14 to $16.

text.p: SeaChange International Inc raised the estimated pricing range for its proposed initial public offering to $14 to $16 a share, according to regulatory filing.
The Maynard, Massachusetts company, which plans to offer 2.0 million shares, previously planned to price them in a range of $12 to $14.

The company, which provides software-based products to manage, store and distribute digital video for cabletelevision operators and telecommunications companies, is expected to go public sometime this week according to lead underwriter Morgan Stanley.
The company has proposed to trade on the Nasdaq under the symbol "SEAC".
